name: pr-exploration-bench2
description: A small exploratory benchmark for evaluating model responses across a variety of short prompts and prompt-engineering variants. It is intended for diagnosing model behavior, instruction-following, and generation quality in exploratory settings rather than as a standardized leaderboard. Useful for rapid prototyping and qualitative comparison of model outputs.
reputation: Niche/experimental dataset primarily used for exploratory research and internal testing rather than broad community benchmarking.
